title: TruthfulQA-Under-Pressure: Adding a Persuasion Layer to a Classic Benchmark

original_idea.body: TruthfulQA-Under-Pressure. Problem: no extension wraps each TruthfulQA item in escalating persuasive pushback to measure pressure-induced truthfulness loss. Direction: for items answered truthfully, append a persuasion turn asserting the misconception with authority, re-ask, measure truth abandonment rate; release as a drop-in add-on.
